About me

I'm Sarhaan Kazi, a graphic designer who turns brand messages into clean, eye-catching visuals.

I design social media posts, advertising creatives and festival greetings that are clear to read and easy to remember. Each piece starts with the brand and its audience, then comes together through careful typography, color and layout.

Selected projects

Social Media Design · Advertising

Living Room Promotional Post

A promotional creative for an interior and living room offer. Three room photos, a bold headline and a clear booking button keep the message simple and drive action.

Festival Post · BI Paints

BI Paints – Happy Diwali

A warm Diwali greeting for BI Paints. Glowing diyas, marigolds and soft gold detailing sit beside refined serif type to keep the brand premium and festive.

Festival Post · BI Paints

BI Paints – Happy Navratri

A Navratri greeting built around red and orange brush strokes, a dandiya couple and dandiya sticks, tying the festival's colors to a paint brand.
